Bank of Baroda SO Online Form 2026 (1100 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the notification for the post of Specialist Officer SO (Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst). This recruitment has been issued for 1100 posts. Online applying process for Bank of Baroda Executive, Credit Analyst Recruitment 2026 has started on 04 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 24 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of Baroda Executive, Credit Analyst Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 04 September 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 24 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Date : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : ₹ 850/-
  • SC, ST, PWD, ESM/DESM : ₹ 175/-
  • All Category Women : ₹ 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
